what: On the drag-to-view board, the three-line hint text (“Drag / to / Discover”) trails the cursor late at a .1 ratio. When the cursor moves right, the top line tilts −10°, the middle shifts +20px and the bottom tilts +10° (reversed when moving left) at a .08 ratio, then straightens after 150ms of stillness, like handwritten lettering swaying in the wind.

options.tilt: Top and bottom row tilt (deg), default 10
options.idle: Time from stopping to standing again (ms), default 150
options.[data-fx-part=word]: Three lines — top, middle, bottom order

use:
DragtoDiscover
…Drag panel…

from.where: index.js works grid “Drag to Discover” cursor (original mouseStoker: EASE .1, SVG_EASE .08, by left-right movement direction svg1 ∓10°·svg2 ±20rem·svg3 ±10°, IDLE_DELAY 150ms, hidden over the header text and bottom bar)

note: The original moves fixed text relative to screen center and hides it over the header and bottom bar — the part moves relative to the area it is attached to and turns off when leaving that area
